sources.title: Australian Government DCCEEW: Flatback turtle
sources.supports: Distribution, Australian breeding sites and soft-bottom habitats.

sources.title: Queensland Government: Sea turtle nesting areas mapping
sources.supports: Regional nesting calendars; based on Marine Turtle Breeding and Migration Atlas Project (2021). Nesting months are not migration dates.

sources.title: Hays et al. (2000): The diving behaviour of green turtles at Ascension Island
sources.supports: Six inter-nesting females; routine resting dive depths of 18–20 m. Surface-to-20 m band in species.json is an editorial summary.

sources.title: Iverson et al. (2019): Loggerhead sea turtle diving changes with productivity, behavioral mode, and sea surface temperature
sources.supports: 26 adult female tracks, northern Gulf of Mexico; approximately 80% of time at 0–30 m; study maximum 160 m.

sources.title: Witt et al. (2011): Tracking leatherback turtles from the world's largest rookery
sources.supports: Gabon post-nesting dispersal; predominantly surface–200 m; maximum recorded 1080 m. No coordinates extracted from figures.

sources.title: Gaos et al. (2012): Dive behaviour of adult hawksbills in the eastern Pacific Ocean
sources.supports: Study-specific shallow depth use, mostly within 10 m; not a universal species limit.

sources.title: Sasso and Witzell (2006): Diving behaviour of an immature Kemp's ridley turtle from Gullivan Bay
sources.supports: Single immature turtle; normal bottom-associated behaviour in 2–3 m water. Not a population estimate.

sources.title: McMahon et al. (2007): Satellite tracking reveals unusual diving characteristics for the olive ridley turtle
sources.supports: Northern Australia; individual mean maximum depths 20.1–46.7 m; recorded maximum 200 ± 20 m. Means and dive ranges are different statistics.

sources.title: Sperling et al. (2010): Diving behaviour in two distinct populations of gravid Flatback turtles
sources.supports: Inter-nesting TDR study: maximum 29 m at Curtis Island, 44 m at Bare Sand Island.

sources.title: SWOT: Online Map & Sea Turtle Database
sources.supports: Discovery source only. Nesting and telemetry records hosted at OBIS-SEAMAP; data reuse subject to SWOT terms and requests. No raw tracks downloaded.

sources.title: OBIS: Access OBIS data
sources.supports: Occurrence access and field definitions. Bathymetry is seabed depth, not measured turtle depth. No raw records downloaded in this session.

sources.title: OBIS-SEAMAP: Chelonioidea species profile, CSV point-observation export (request 101809)
sources.supports: User-provided ZIP export contains 1,835 point observations dated 2006–2020, not linked migration trajectories. The points CSV has no depth fields and no populated series IDs, so it provides neither individual tracks nor swimming-depth measurements. The archive includes per-dataset citations and reuse policies.

sources.title: Josephson and Palka: NEFSC Aerial Circle-Back Abundance Survey 2006
sources.supports: Four CC0 point observations labelled unidentified turtle (Chelonioidea), all dated July 2006. They are sightings, not an identified animal's track; no swimming depths are supplied.

sources.title: Ampela and Bacon: HRC Koa Kai-11 Marine Species Monitoring Aerial Surveys November 2010
sources.supports: 101 turtle-labelled point observations from November 2010 in the supplied profile export. CC-BY; OBIS-SEAMAP archive terms restrict redistribution without consent. Not an individual track and no depth measurements.

sources.title: Ampela and Bacon: HRC SCC Aerial-Based Monitoring Survey February 2010
sources.supports: 12 unidentified-turtle point observations from February 2010 in the supplied profile export. CC-BY; OBIS-SEAMAP archive terms restrict redistribution without consent. Not an individual track and no depth measurements.

sources.title: Ampela and Bacon: HRC Koa Kai Marine Species Monitoring Vessel Surveys November 2010
sources.supports: One unidentified-turtle point observation from November 2010 in the supplied profile export. CC-BY; OBIS-SEAMAP archive terms restrict redistribution without consent. Not an individual track and no depth measurements.

sources.title: Pool and de Boer: SeaTurtle surveys on Braamspunt by Green Heritage Fund of Suriname
sources.supports: 90 point observations from March 2020 in the supplied profile export: 86 turtle nests and 4 poached-nest records. CC-BY-NC; OBIS-SEAMAP archive terms restrict redistribution without consent. Nest points are not swimming locations or tracks.

sources.title: NOAA InPort: Kemps Ridley and Loggerhead Tracking data in GOM
sources.supports: Potential actual telemetry source for two species. Catalog inspected; files not downloaded.
